$comment: RAHU — Dimension-style AI coworker, 100% Google ecosystem, no separate UI. Outputs land as Gmail drafts/labels, Calendar events, Google Tasks, and Google Docs. >>> REVIEW THIS FILE, then copy it to .claude/settings.json to activate. It is shipped as .example so nothing auto-grants permissions or registers hooks without your explicit opt-in. <<<
$comment_model: Default = Sonnet (good writing + reasoning). Per-task overrides live in each agent's frontmatter: Haiku for high-volume triage/extraction, Opus for deal/IC-memo deep reasoning. See README 'Model routing'.
$comment_no_mcp_here: The Google server is declared ONCE, in the repo-root .mcp.json — NOT here. `mcpServers` is not a settings.json key, so a copy here is silently ignored (or shadows .mcp.json); either way it drifts. A duplicate block used to live here and had already diverged, hardcoding Asia/Kolkata while .mcp.json honored ${WORKSPACE_MCP_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE:-UTC}. Set the timezone by exporting that variable.
$comment_alt_mcp: The claude.ai-hosted Gmail / Google Calendar / Google Drive connectors need no OAuth app and are now fully supported here: agents dual-grant both the self-hosted google-workspace tools (mcp__google-workspace__*) and the hosted ones (mcp__claude_ai_Gmail__*, mcp__claude_ai_Google_Calendar__*, mcp__claude_ai_Google_Drive__*). Remaining hosted-only limitations: no Google Tasks (action items fall back to a Doc checklist/draft instead of a real Task), no Doc update-in-place, and no send — hosted Gmail is draft-only by design.
$comment_permissions: SAFETY POSTURE: RAHU drafts, labels, and prepares — it never sends mail or writes calendar events without a human OK. Reads, label ops, task management, doc create/read/update/search, drive search/read/create, and draft creation (both connector families) are silent/allowed. The only send tool that exists anywhere, mcp__google-workspace__send_gmail_message, always asks — hosted Gmail has no send tool at all, so it is inherently draft-only. Calendar writes (mcp__google-workspace__manage_event, mcp__claude_ai_Google_Calendar__create_event / update_event) always ask too. This mirrors Dimension's review-and-send default. Flip send_gmail_message into 'allow' only if you knowingly opt into true Inbox-Autopilot auto-send.

hooks.$comment_hooks: Optional. Enable by copying into settings.json. SessionStart injects a compact memory digest so agents start context-aware for ~0 extra tokens. PreToolUse on send is a belt-and-suspenders guard.

PreToolUse.$comment: Regex matcher (not an exact name) so the send-latch fires for ANY Gmail send tool. Its live target today is the self-hosted workspace-mcp tool mcp__google-workspace__send_gmail_message, caught by the [Ss]end.*[Mm]ail and [Gg]mail.*[Ss]end classes — the hosted claude.ai Gmail connector has NO send tool at all (draft-only), so there is nothing hosted-side for this guard to catch yet. The send_email / send_message alternates are belt-and-suspenders for future/other connectors that might use those literal names. Case classes are explicit: Claude Code compiles this with JS RegExp, where a leading (?i) is a COMPILE ERROR that silently disables the latch entirely. Do not reintroduce it.
